phases.note: Two of the four plan-review rounds exposed PRD defects, not plan defects: an AC gap (resolved by the owner-approved AC-11 amendment) and, ironically, that amendment's own wording making a plan VALIDATE vacuous.
Approved first try at every gate. A Level 1 prettier failure on a test file was resolved by the command layer's formatter_cmd, not by the implementer, per the R-X x Level 1 deadlock rule.

Adding two schema tables tripped unit 5's export-completeness guard, working exactly as designed. The AC-5 throw-path test was found not to run at all, then found to pass regardless of implementation; fixed and proved discriminating by experiment.
A test-side coverage gap was ruled against the project's own Browser-API rule and closed with a production change (extracting the payload parser). The plan was amended under a dated note.
